new.name: Art Flick's Dun Variant
new.description: Art Flick's big Catskill variant with a dark dun tail, a stripped Rhode Island Red hackle quill body and an oversized dark dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in Catskill riffles during big mayfly hatches like the Isonychia.
mats: Stripped Rhode Island Red rooster hackle quill
Dark dun rooster, twice the gape
steps: Tie in a stiff dark dun tail.
Soak and wrap a stripped hackle quill body for clean segments.
Tie in an oversized dark dun hackle.
Wind it in close turns and finish.

new.name: August Dun
new.description: A British dry with a light dun tail, a red-brown floss body with gold rib, brown hen hackle tip wings and a honey hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during late summer mayfly hatches.
steps: Tie in hen hackle tip wings upright.
Tie in a light dun tail and the rib.
Wind a floss body and rib it.
Wind a honey hackle around the wings.

new.name: Bird's Stone
new.description: Cal Bird's salmonfly dry with moose hair tails and antennae, an orange floss body ribbed with palmered and trimmed furnace hackle, a deer wing and a furnace hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during the salmonfly hatch on western rivers.
steps: Tie in two split moose hair tails.
Wind an orange floss body and palmer a furnace hackle through it, then trim the hackle short.
Tie in a deer hair wing.
Add moose antennae and wind a furnace hackle in front.

new.name: Black Water Spider
new.description: A buoyant lake spider with a pearl rib, a body of black-green peacock flash dub with black CDC mixed through and a black foam cylinder head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper when beetles and black buzzers are about.
mats: Euro nymph flash dub, black green peacock, with black CDC
steps: Tie in the pearl rib and dub a slim flash body.
Rib the body.
Tie a short foam cylinder on top at the head.
Dub CDC and flash around the foam and pick it out as legs.

new.name: Bubble Emerger
new.description: A soft emerger with a green metallic thread body, a pheasant rump aftershaft wing and a pheasant rump and grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it or let it rise at the end of the drift.
steps: Wrap a slim green metallic thread body.
Tie in a fluffy aftershaft feather as a wing bubble.
Tie in a pheasant rump and a grizzly hackle.
Wind them together and finish.

new.name: Caddis Poopah
new.description: A caddis pupa with a pearl tinsel underbody, a velvet chenille body, a copper rib, mallard antennae, partridge legs and an ostrich head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near the bottom and let it swing up.
steps: Wrap a pearl tinsel underbody and tie in the rib.
Wrap the velvet chenille body and rib it.
Tie in mallard antennae and partridge legs.
Wrap a black ostrich herl head.

new.name: Cannon's Bunny Dun
new.description: A simple mayfly with dun tails, a thread or biot body, a snowshoe rabbit's foot wing and a beaver thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in flat water during mayfly hatches.
mats: Dun thread or grey goose biot
steps: Tie in split tails.
Build a slim body.
Tie in a snowshoe wing upright.
Dub the thorax around the wing.

new.name: Catgut Caddis Pupa
new.description: A weighted caddis pupa with a natural catgut body over white mink, a dark thorax, partridge legs and hen pheasant horns.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in rivers during caddis season.
mats: Yellow 70 denier, brown 8/0 and yellow silk
Natural catgut over white mink fur
steps: Add lead and the bead.
Dub white mink and wrap catgut over it for a segmented body.
Dub the thorax and add partridge legs.
Tie in hen pheasant horns and finish.

new.name: CDC Olive Quill
new.description: An olive quill dry with a dark dun tail, an olive peacock quill body, a dark grey CDC wing and a BWO thorax.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Wrap an olive quill body.
Tie in a CDC wing.
Dub the thorax around the wing.

new.name: Chan's Chironomid
new.description: Brian Chan's chironomid with a white Antron tail and gills, a silver tinsel body, a peacock thorax and a pheasant tail casing.
new.fishing_tips: Hang it just off the bottom under an indicator.
steps: Tie in a short white Antron tail.
Wrap a silver tinsel body.
Tie in pheasant tail for the casing and wrap a peacock thorax.
Pull the casing over and tie in white gills at the head.

new.name: Clown Egg
new.description: A McFly Foam egg in the clown mix of colours, tied on a short scud hook.
steps: Tie a small bunch of mixed foam on top of the shank.
Pull it upright and wrap around the base.
Trim it into a round ball.
Whip finish under the egg.

new.name: Conehead Bunny Muddler
new.description: A cone head muddler with a black zonker tail and back, pearl flash and a spun deer hair collar.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Slide on the cone and wrap the weight.
Tie in a rabbit strip tail and back with flash.
Spin a deer hair collar behind the cone.
Trim the collar and finish.

new.name: Craft Fur Clouser
new.description: A Clouser tied with craft fur instead of bucktail, with large white dumbbell eyes and gold flash.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and hop it for stripers, reds and snook.
mats: Four strands of gold Krystal Flash
steps: Tie the dumbbell eyes a third back from the eye.
Tie a craft fur belly in front of the eyes.
Add the flash.
Tie craft fur on top as the back and finish.

new.name: Craven's Screaming Banshee
new.description: A flashy caddis with a forward elk wing, a pearl Flashabou body, a brown thorax and an elk overwing.
steps: Tie a short elk wing forward over the eye.
Wrap a pearl Flashabou body.
Dub a brown thorax.
Tie in an elk overwing and finish.

new.name: Crime Scene Caddis
new.description: A caddis with a ribbed squirrel abdomen, root beer flash, a CDC wing, a white foam indicator and a hackle stacker.
steps: Dub and rib the abdomen.
Tie in a CDC wing with flash.
Add a foam indicator.
Build a hackle stacker on a superfloss post.

new.name: Darling Darting Damsel
new.description: A damsel with a gold bead, bead chain eyes, an ostrich tail, a D-Rib abdomen, a medallion wing case, a peacock thorax and hare legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it with slow strips near weed beds.
steps: Mount the bead and eyes.
Tie in an ostrich tail and wrap a D-Rib abdomen.
Tie in the wing case and wrap a peacock thorax with hare legs.
Pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: DDH Leech
new.description: A simple steelhead and trout leech with gold bead chain eyes, an olive marabou tail and an olive Simi Seal body.
steps: Tie on bead chain eyes.
Tie in a marabou tail.
Dub a Simi Seal body.
Brush it out and finish.

new.name: Duck Dun
new.description: A CDC dun with a speckled dun tail, a light olive body and a blue dun hackle.
steps: Tie in a CDC wing.
Tie in the tail.
Dub the body.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Dumb Bunny
new.description: A jig-hook bunny with a chartreuse zonker belly, small dumbbell eyes and a dark olive zonker back.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along the bottom for bass and trout.
steps: Tie the dumbbell eyes at the jig bend.
Tie in a chartreuse zonker belly.
Tie a dark olive zonker on top as the back.
Finish behind the eyes.

new.name: Fatal Attractor
new.description: An attractor caddis with a red flash tail, a green Ice Dub body, a deer and poly wing and a grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in a flash tail.
Dub an Ice Dub body.
Tie in deer hair then poly yarn wings.
Wind the grizzly hackle.

new.name: Fish Skull Super Bugger
new.description: A bugger with an olive marabou tail, pearl flash, olive chenille, a schlappen hackle and a silver Fish Skull head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Tie in the tail and flash.
Wrap the chenille body.
Palmer the schlappen.
Glue on the Fish Skull head.

new.name: Foxy Clouser
new.description: A Clouser made of red fox fur with copper flash and red lead eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for reds and seatrout.
steps: Tie on the eyes.
Tie in a fox tail.
Add flash.
Tie a fox collar and finish.

new.name: Francis
new.description: A vintage wet with a gold tag, a peacock body ribbed with red floss, dun hackle tip wings and a dun hackle.
steps: Tie a gold tag.
Wrap peacock and rib it with red floss.
Wind a dun hackle.
Tie hackle tip wings on top.

new.name: Glen Grant Spey
new.description: A classic Spey fly with a rump feather tail, a yellow and black body, oval and flat silver ribs and a long schlappen body hackle.
new.fishing_tips: A classic dressing for display or big rivers.
mats: Large oval and flat silver tinsel
steps: Tie in a rump feather tail.
Wind the two-part body.
Rib it with oval and flat tinsel and wind the hackle between the ribs.
Add the wing and finish.

new.name: Golden Spinner
new.description: A vintage wet with gold tag and rib, an orange floss body, a soft light hackle and dark duck quill wings.
mats: Light dun or tan soft rooster
steps: Tie a flat gold tag.
Wind an orange floss body and rib it with oval gold.
Tie in a soft light hackle.
Tie dark duck quill wings on top.

new.name: Hedgehog
new.description: A loch fly with a hare and gold Lite-Brite body and head and a roe deer wing tied in along the body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a bob fly.
mats: Hare's mask fur with gold Lite-Brite
steps: Dub a short section of body.
Tie in a bunch of roe deer.
Repeat along the shank.
Dub the head and trim the hair.

new.name: Hula Damsel
new.description: A damsel on a wiggle shank with an ostrich tail, a tubing tail section, fluorocarbon eyes and a CDC and Ice Dub body.
mats: Olive CDC and light olive Ice Dub
steps: Build the ostrich and tubing tail on the shank.
Connect the shank to the hook.
Add the burnt mono eyes.
Dub a CDC and Ice Dub body.

new.name: Jig Napoleon
new.description: A jig nymph with a copper bead and a hot orange thread base.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line.
steps: Slide on the copper bead and wrap lead-free wire behind it.
Tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Dub a slim tapered body.
Finish with a hot orange thread collar behind the bead.

new.name: Jim's Damsel
new.description: A damsel with a marabou tail, an olive pheasant tail back, an Antron body and rubber legs.
steps: Add a bead or a few turns of lead.
Tie in an olive marabou tail and a pheasant tail strip for the back.
Dub an Antron body, pull the pheasant tail over and tie it down.
Add rubber legs at the thorax and pull the wing case over.

new.name: Ken's Crazy Ant
new.description: An ant cut from foam drawer liner with an Antron wing and grizzly legs.
steps: Cut a strip of foam drawer liner and tie it down to form a rear and front hump.
Leave a few strands at the front as antennae.
Tie in a short Antron wing at the waist.
Wind a grizzly hackle at the waist for legs and finish.

new.name: Kennebago Muddler
new.description: A Maine muddler with a flank tail, a gold body, a squirrel underwing, a flank overwing and a deer collar.
steps: Tie in a flank fibre tail.
Wrap a gold tinsel body.
Tie in a sparse squirrel underwing and a flank overwing.
Spin a deer hair collar and head and trim it short.

new.name: Kinermony Killer
new.description: A Scottish salmon fly with a silver and black body, a yellow middle hackle and hot orange and blue hackles.
mats: Silver holographic tinsel and black floss
steps: Tag.
Rear body and middle hackle.
Front body and rib.
Hackles.

new.name: Landon Mayer's Mini
new.description: A small leech with a holo tinsel underbody, a pine squirrel rear body and an ostrich front.
steps: Wrap a brown holo tinsel underbody.
Wind a zonked pine squirrel strip over the rear of the body.
Wrap black ostrich herl at the front.
Whip finish.

new.name: Male Dace
new.description: A feather-wing streamer with a gold rib, a cream floss body, an orange throat and olive and badger wings with jungle cock.
mats: Two olive and two golden badger hackles
steps: Wind a cream floss body and rib it with gold.
Tie in an orange hackle throat.
Set two olive and two golden badger hackles as the wing.
Add jungle cock cheeks and build a black head.

new.name: Matt's Gnat
new.description: A tiny midge cluster with a peacock body and a snowshoe rabbit's foot dubbing loop.
mats: Snowshoe rabbit's foot in a waxed loop
steps: Wrap a peacock herl body.
Spin snowshoe rabbit's foot fibres in a waxed dubbing loop.
Wrap the loop at the front.
Trim it to shape and finish.

new.name: Missoulian
new.description: A muddler-style streamer with a turkey tail, a red butt, a white wool body and a mixed wing.
mats: Barred duck, calf hair and white turkey
steps: Tie in a mottled turkey tail and a red chenille butt.
Wrap a white wool body and rib it with silver.
Tie in a wing of barred duck, calf hair and white turkey.
Spin a deer hair collar and clip a short head.

new.name: Neversink
new.description: A vintage wet with black tails, a gold tag, a yellow floss body, a ginger hackle and mallard wings.
steps: Tie in three black barbs as a tail and a gold tag.
Wind a yellow floss body.
Tie in a long ginger hackle wet style.
Tie rolled mallard wings and finish a lacquered head.

new.name: Nitro Caddis Pupa
new.description: A caddis pupa with a cyclops bead, a pearl braid tail, medallion wing pads, mallard antennae and hen legs.
steps: Slide on the cyclops bead.
Wrap a pearl braid body.
Tie in medallion sheeting wing pads and mallard antennae.
Wind an India hen collar for legs.

new.name: Olive Adams
new.description: An Adams in olive with a dun tail, an olive brown body, dun hackle tip wings and grizzly and ginger hackles.
steps: Tie in dun hackle tip wings.
Tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Dub an olive brown body.
Wind grizzly and ginger hackles around the wings.

new.name: Olive Spider
new.description: A spider with a yellow thread body, a marker-coloured rib and a yellow mallard covert hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in spring olive hatches.
steps: Wrap a slim yellow thread body.
Rib it with a piece of yellow thread coloured with a brown pen.
Tie in a yellow mallard covert feather.
Wind two turns and finish.

new.name: Orange Bumble
new.description: A bumble with an orange silk body, peacock sword, gold tinsel and palmered honey dun hen.
mats: Orange silk with peacock sword and fine gold tinsel
steps: Tie in a honey dun hen, peacock sword and gold tinsel at the bend.
Wrap an orange silk body.
Palmer the hen hackle and rib with tinsel and peacock.
Wind a honey dun hen at the front and finish.

new.name: Pat's Plus
new.description: A Pat's Rubber Legs variant with a tungsten bead and chenille body.
steps: Slide on the bead and wrap the wire.
Tie in rubber leg tails.
Wrap variegated chenille, tying in rubber legs at two points.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Reuben Wood
new.description: A vintage wet with a red tag, a mallard tail, a white chenille body, a brown hackle and mallard tip wings.
steps: Tie a red floss tag and a mallard tail.
Wrap a white chenille body.
Tie in a brown hackle wet style.
Tie mallard flank tip wings and finish a lacquered head.

new.name: Shenk's Minnow
new.description: Ed Shenk's minnow with a white marabou tail and a baby blanket yarn body.
steps: Wrap lead-free wire on the shank.
Tie in a white marabou tail.
Wrap a baby blanket yarn body.
Brush and trim it to a minnow shape.

new.name: Shiney Hiney Caddis Pupa
new.description: A caddis pupa with a glass bead gas bubble at the rear, a stretch rib body and a CDC collar.
steps: Slide a glass bead to the bend as a gas bubble.
Wrap a green stretch rib body.
Wind a rusty dun CDC collar.
Dub a small thorax and finish.

new.name: Squirrel and Herl Bugger
new.description: A bugger with a peacock body, an olive pine squirrel tail and an olive grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in an olive pine squirrel tail.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Palmer an olive grizzly hackle.
Finish.

new.name: Stalcup's Gilled Nymph
new.description: A mayfly nymph with an ostrich tail and body, a copper rib, a medallion casing and partridge legs.
steps: Tie in ostrich herl as tail and body.
Wrap the ostrich and rib it with copper wire.
Tie in the medallion casing and dub the thorax.
Add partridge legs and pull the casing over.

new.name: Steel Blue Wet
new.description: A spider with a steel blue silk body, a palmered steel blue hen and a peacock rib between coloured silks.
mats: Peacock herl with orange and red silk twist
steps: Build a steel blue silk body.
Palmer a steel blue hen hackle.
Rib it with peacock herl between twisted coloured silks.
Wind a steel blue hen at the front.

new.name: Taneycomo Sculpin
new.description: A charcoal rabbit sculpin with dumbbell eyes, a grizzly hackle and a scud dubbing head.
steps: Tie on weighted dumbbell eyes.
Tie in a charcoal rabbit strip tail and wrap it as the body.
Wind a grizzly hackle.
Dub a grey scud head around the eyes.

new.name: Winkler's Balanced Leather Leech
new.description: A balanced leech with a leech leather tail and a Simi Seal body on a pin.
steps: Fix the bead on a dressmaker's pin and lash it to the hook.
Tie in a leech leather tail.
Dub a Simi Seal body.
Pick it out and finish.
